scope: private anonymous stdio of the native adapter's job-owned shadow policy child

policy: no public response or publication authority

framing.request: HP1 Q request_id policy_epoch engine_epoch publication_generation kind a b c context_hex_or_dash
framing.response: HP1 R request_id policy_epoch engine_epoch publication_generation kind decision
framing.encoding: ASCII; decimal unsigned inputs; copied UTF-8 context as lowercase hex, never eval
framing.stream: partial and multiple reads are assembled; CR and unknown versions/kinds/invalid fields fail closed

identity: Request IDs monotonically increase across policy replacements. Each policy launch and engine launch advances its own epoch. Successful native publication advances a diagnostic generation. All four identifiers and kind must match; no policy result is adopted.
timeout: Log timeout; retain the single outstanding ID while draining and discarding its late response for at most 5 s. Retire channel on malformed reply, child death, drain timeout or shutdown before another request is sent. Native work never waits.
saturation: Try-lock/value queue drops shadow observations on contention, count/byte cap or oversized context. No native work, acknowledged learning or public response is dropped.

2.name: sources
2.decision: disabled=0, built-ins then server=1, server only=2

3.name: restart
3.decision: success resets 1000; failure doubles capped at 30000

4.name: cache
4.decision: expired=1 using hit 60000 / miss 2000 ms TTL

5.name: publication
5.decision: publish intent if a AND b AND c

qualification.os_pause: Suspend only a verified job-owned policy child for 3 s; force a source observation; verify timeout and late discard, native cached replies, learning/publication and soak.
qualification.lisp_pause: DDSKK_HOST_POLICY_TEST_PAUSE_KIND=5 blocks the policy event loop for 3 s on publication observations, gated by diagnostics and a Software\NativeIME-test- registry key; for private TSF/Emacs qualification. The runtime lacks sleep-for; this injection uses float-time on the isolated policy process.
qualification.negative_control: Separate test-host/s3 executable defines NATIVEIME_POLICY_SYNCHRONOUS_CONTROL and synchronously waits on the real shadow channel from ServeClient. The identical isolation gate must fail.
